question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a red ball, Bob has a brown ball, and Claire has a orange ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Finally, Alice and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) red ball
(B) brown ball
(C) orange ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (red, brown, orange)
After Alice and Claire swap: (orange, brown, red)
After Alice and Bob swap: (brown, orange, red)
After Alice and Claire swap: (red, orange, brown)
Bob has the orange ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
